title: fix(lint)!: the view and object publish doors refuse a list-view chart whose dataset or measure does not resolve
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBPTDEzru2zMrxajEdXBRvAB)_

Fixes #26847

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` gains the rule and its remedy; no `skills/**` file teaches list-view chart bindings, so no skill changes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：列表视图的图表如果引用了不存在的数据集，或 `values` 写了数据集里没有的度量（维度同理），通过视图或对象发布时直接拒绝（422），给出与 `os validate` 相同的结论；草稿保存不拦。
- 为什么改：Studio 或 MCP 作者拼错数据集名、或把原始字段名当度量写，以前发布返回 200，保存下来的图表是空的或坏的，没有任何提示，而 CLI 对同一份文件会报错。
- 风险与回滚：没有改任何 schema，只是让已有的 lint 规则在视图/对象发布门也运行；仓内 examples 与 platform-objects 没有视图或对象被拒（实测 2 个图表列表视图，0 条结论）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.ts`（列表视图遍历新增的两种独立视图形态）、`packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`（`validateChartBindings` 一行的 `runtimeTypes` 与上方注释）、`packages/rest/src/meta-view-chart-binding.test.ts` 末尾的 `#26847` 段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-chart-bindings.test.ts -t 26847`，应见 24 条全绿（三种视图形态 × 未知数据集 / 未知度量 / 对照，加对象发布门与运行时门）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（窄化需先过契约档复核）。

## What changes

`validateChartBindings` (`packages/lint`) already gave `chart-dataset-unknown`, `chart-dimension-unknown` and `chart-measure-unknown` for a list-view chart under `os validate`, but the runtime publish door never ran it for a view or an object. Two things kept it out:

1. **The suite row.** `reference-integrity-suite.ts` declared `runtimeTypes: ['flow', 'report']`. It is now `['flow', 'report', 'view', 'object']`, and the comment above the row is rewritten: a list-view chart resolves against `stack.datasets` alone, which every per-write snapshot carries, so crossing it opens no missing-collection false-positive channel. The rule's report, page and dashboard surfaces read collections a view or object snapshot does not carry, so on those writes they find nothing.
2. **The walk.** The list-view walk read `views[].list`, `views[].listViews.KEY` and `objects[].listViews.KEY`, but not the two standalone shapes `PUT /api/v1/meta/view` hands the suite: the flattened list overlay (`viewKind: 'list'`, chart at the top level) and the ViewItem record (`viewKind: 'list'`, chart inside `config`). Both rungs are added, recognised the way `validateListViewFieldRefs` recognises them. Without them, adding `view` to `runtimeTypes` would have been a no-op for those two shapes.

One guard moves with it: the rule's early return (`no datasets, no reports, no views, no pages`) now also looks at `objects`, so an object list view naming a dataset in a stack that declares none is reported instead of skipped. That is what makes the `object` door judge an object written into an environment with no datasets.

The verdicts are unchanged: `chart-dataset-unknown` at `chart.dataset`, `chart-measure-unknown` at `chart.values[i]`, `chart-dimension-unknown` at `chart.dimensions[i]`, all `error`, so the publish answers `422 INVALID_METADATA`. A draft save is not gated.

## Why

A Studio or MCP author who mistypes a dataset name, or names a measure the dataset lacks, gets a saved view whose chart renders empty or broken. Nothing says why, and the CLI would have refused the same file.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.test.ts`, new `[#26847]` block (24 cases): each of the three view shapes (ViewItem `config`, flattened overlay, container `listViews` member) gives `chart-dataset-unknown` and `chart-measure-unknown` at the right path, with a clean control; a ViewItem record is walked at `config` only; an object list view in a stack with no datasets is reported. At the runtime door (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, the function `metadata-protocol` calls): a lit probe per verdict per view shape and on an object write, each with a clean control, and a pin that the row declares `view` and `object`.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-view-chart-binding.test.ts`, new `#26847` block (9 cases) on the real composition (real `RestServer` route, real `saveMetaItem`, real `ObjectQL` + SQLite `sys_metadata`): per shape, `no_such_dataset` → 422 `INVALID_METADATA` with `chart-dataset-unknown` at `….chart.dataset` and nothing stored; `ghost_measure` → 422 with `chart-measure-unknown` at `….chart.values[0]` and nothing stored; the control → 200 and stored. The file's `boot()` now publishes the `lead_metrics` dataset its fixtures bind, through `PUT /api/v1/meta/dataset`: the existing #22491 control bound that dataset without declaring it, and is refused now that the door resolves it.
- Re-judged pins: the `view` and `object` member-surface rosters (`runtime-gate.view-writes.test.ts`, `runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts`) gain `validateChartBindings` with the argument written beside them. The #26719 save-door probes in `validate-list-view-field-refs.test.ts` charted `status` / `task_count` against the person dataset, which declares neither; they now select names their dataset declares, so the foreign object stays the only thing wrong with them.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured before the change, at the real door.** On `main` `20457f6f`, with the same harness as the new REST block and a declared `lead_metrics` dataset, all six bad PUTs answered `200` (three shapes × `no_such_dataset` / `ghost_measure`), and the three controls `200`. On this branch the six answer `422` at `views[0].config.chart.dataset` / `views[0].chart.dataset` / `views[0].listViews.pipeline.chart.dataset` (and `….values[0]` for the measure), the controls still `200`. The lint dist was rebuilt from each tree before its run.
- **Shipped corpus, measured at the door's snapshot shape before crossing**, on `21e8217b`: every view sent through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules({ type: 'view' })` and every object with `listViews` through `{ type: 'object' }`, each with its own stack's objects and datasets as context. `examples/app-crm` 3 views / 6 objects, `examples/app-todo` 1 / 1, `examples/app-showcase` 6 views / 24 objects / 4 datasets, `examples/app-multi-package` none, `packages/platform-objects` 53 objects (29 with `listViews`). Two list views chart (showcase `task` `chart`, `project` `budget_chart`): 0 chart findings at either door. A lit probe (the showcase chart rebound to an unknown dataset) is refused. `apps/` holds only the docs site; a repo-wide search for `type: 'chart'` outside tests finds no other list-view chart.
- **Not changed:** `dashboard` and `page` writes still do not run this member; their surfaces are owned by their sibling rules.

## Verification

All local, on `35d40a9e`, through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (every VERDICT line `command-exit 0`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 169 passed (169), Tests 7490 passed (7490). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: Test Files 328 passed (328), Tests 6522 passed, 326 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 270 passed, 4 skipped (274), Tests 21666 passed, 26 skipped.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (merge base `20457f6f`, 6 paths): 88 derived families, 86 exit 0. `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (prerequisite: they read a full build); they re-run after `pnpm build`, and that reading, the full dogfood battery on the final head and the `--ran` reconciliation are in the os-dev report on #26847.
- Before/after at the real REST door: see the first acceptance note.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `eslint --no-inline-config` on the seven changed source and test files exits 0 (the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
